title: Non-specific vs specific DNA binding free energetics of a transcription factor domain protein for target search and recognition
authors: Carmen Al Masri; Biao Wan; Jin Yu
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全原子分子动力学模拟和随机动力学建模，定量揭示转录因子结构域蛋白在非特异与特异DNA结合间的自由能差异（约10 kBT），阐明搜索与识别模式仅由蛋白在DNA上的取向区分，并探讨侧翼序列对解离动力学测量的影响，高度契合TF-DNA结合与互作机制建模课题。
abstract: Transcription factor (TF) proteins regulate gene expression by binding to specific sites on the genome. In the facilitated diffusion model, an optimized search process is achieved by the TF protein alternating between 3D diffusion in the bulk and 1D diffusion along DNA. While undergoing 1D diffusion, the protein can switch from a search mode for fast diffusion along non-specific DNA to a recognition mode for stable binding to specific DNA. It was recently noticed that for a small TF domain protein, re-orientations on DNA other than conformational changes happen between the non-specific and specific DNA binding. We here conducted all-atom molecular dynamics simulations with steering forces to reveal the protein-DNA binding free energetics, with a difference between the non-specific and specific binding about 10 k B T , confirming that the search and recognition modes are distinguished only by protein orientations on the DNA. As the binding free energy difference differs from that being estimated from experimental measurements about 4-5 k B T on 15-bp DNA constructs, we hypothesize that the discrepancy comes from DNA sequences flanking the 6-bp central binding sites impacting on the dissociation kinetics measurements. The hypothesis is supported by a simplified spherical protein-DNA model along with stochastic simulations and kinetic modeling.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TF）蛋白通过结合基因组上的特定位点来调控基因表达。在促进扩散模型中，优化搜索过程通过TF蛋白在体相中的三维扩散与沿DNA的一维扩散之间交替实现。在进行一维扩散时，蛋白可以从用于沿非特异性DNA快速扩散的搜索模式切换到用于稳定结合特异性DNA的识别模式。最近注意到，对于小型TF结构域蛋白，在非特异性和特异性DNA结合之间发生的不是构象变化，而是DNA上的重新定向。我们在此进行了带引导力的全原子分子动力学模拟，以揭示蛋白-DNA结合的自由能学，非特异性结合与特异性结合之间的差异约为10 k B T，证实搜索和识别模式仅通过蛋白在DNA上的取向来区分。由于结合自由能差异与实验测量在15-bp DNA构建体上估计的约4-5 k B T不同，我们假设这一差异源于侧翼于6-bp中心结合位点的DNA序列对解离动力学测量的影响。该假设得到了简化球形蛋白-DNA模型以及随机模拟和动力学建模的支持。
